violations.text: The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

The facility is lacking drain stoppers for the 3-bay, establishment was observed using paper towels to manually stop water drainage. Establishment shall obtain drain stoppers to facilitate manual ware washing. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026
The receptacle in the women's toilet room is lacking a cover. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026
The ceiling in the food service area is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. New Violation. Correct By: 09/18/2026

The floor in the walk-in cooler was observed missing or pulling away from insulation beneath and is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/18/2026
